pipeline.title: How to own INFINITE properties starting from £100K - the off-plan compounding ladder
pipeline.hook: Infinite properties starting from 100K - the compounding ladder
pipeline.notes: The snowball mechanic: enter one payment plan -> pay through construction -> sell at/near handover at profit -> recycle proceeds into TWO plans -> four -> eight. Off-plan leverage = you control the full asset's appreciation on 10-20% deposits, so each cycle multiplies. BUILD WITH REAL MATHS: e.g. 100K GBP ~ 460K AED = deposits on 1x ~900K-1M unit; 3yr cycle at conservative appreciation; show cycle 1 -> 2 -> 3 with honest numbers ON SCREEN (whiteboard/deck format - EP-style). CRITICAL HONESTY RAILS (the differentiator): this only works when (a) you buy the RIGHT projects (rogue-developer secret applies), (b) market cooperates - a flat cycle pauses the ladder, doesn't kill it, (c) exit liquidity is real (Dubai yes, frontier emirates harder), (d) fees/DLD eat into each cycle - include them. Massive hook potential: 'infinite properties' claim + real spreadsheet = shares + saves. Candidate for EP-style deck video or whiteboard. Pairs with 'this is your COVID' timing thesis + skin-in-game (Calum's own ladder = Tara Park units). | Script Mon 3, record Tue 4.
